mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte imbalances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase bleeding risk and reduce clopidogrel's antiplatelet efficacy through impaired metabolism and platelet dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and platelet counts closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; maintain adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; assess bleeding risk benefit-to-harm ratio.
